content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Operates route-based gaming terminals in bars and truck stops, a gambling business unrelated to baseball or ballpark operations."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Billboards, broadband and insurance brokerage are unrelated to owning a sports franchise and ballpark."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Organizes B2B trade shows for exhibitors and trade buyers, not live consumer sports entertainment."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Operates casual restaurants, package liquor stores and franchising, with no live sports or ballpark business."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Supermarket and fuel retailer selling groceries to households, a different business from sports entertainment."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Concert promotion and ticketing platform for artists; it does not own or run a sports team and its core is music events."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Owns arenas that host sports and live events, with ticketing, food and beverage sales and hospitality, mirroring the ballpark model."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Publishes news, books and property listing portals, a media and publishing business with no live entertainment."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Owns upscale hotels earning room and meeting revenue from travelers, not ticketed live events or a sports team."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Operates casino resorts earning gaming wagers and lodging, a different business from baseball entertainment."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Owns select-service hotels that rent rooms to travelers through franchised brands, unrelated to sports entertainment."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Rents and launders work uniforms to businesses, a B2B service business unrelated to live entertainment."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Operates theme parks selling admission and annual passes to families, an attraction business rather than a sports franchise."}]}
